It seems that the `make` command is attempting to use the wrong compiler (`g++` instead of `nvcc`). We need to ensure that we are using the correct CUDA compiler (`nvcc`) to build the program.

Let's update the makefile to use `nvcc` instead of `g++`.

arguments.content:
# Makefile for texturing programs

CUDA_HOME ?= /usr/local/cuda-12.8
CUDATarget ?= sm_90
CXX ?= $(CUDA_HOME)/bin/nvcc
CXXFLAGS ?= -g -G -O3 -Xptxas -O3 -arch=$(CUDATarget)
LDFLAGS ?=

all: tex1dfetch

tex1dfetch: tex1dfetch.cu
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $< -o $@
